prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production material sheet for an EXISTING medical illustration design system. Match the exact tissue painting style in the THREE supplied approved Kansei reference images. These are the ONLY style references. Do not introduce your own tissue design.
Create one SQUARE high resolution material sheet, ideally 2048x2048, with six flat rectangular tissue swatches in a strictly regular TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid, zero gaps, no borders or captions. Each rectangle occupies exactly one half of the width and one third of height.
TOP LEFT: golden subcutaneous adipose lobules with delicate translucent white septa, exactly the same paint, soft detail and restrained gloss as the knee and pectoralis references. No exaggerated huge orange balls.
TOP RIGHT: longitudinal skeletal muscle, same muted brick red, many fine elongated small fascicles and delicate pearl white wisps and perimysium as the pectoralis and biceps reference. Fibers predominantly left to right. No shiny steak, no fat blobs, no giant white cables.
MIDDLE LEFT: healthy longitudinal tendon, closely packed fine parallel ivory and light beige collagen fibers, exactly matching the quadriceps tendon in the knee reference. Fine detail, continuous fibers, no black voids.
MIDDLE RIGHT: homogeneous tan trabecular bone field, a broad TWO DIMENSIONAL texture of small irregular organic trabeculae, exactly matching the bone paint in the knee reference. Uniform illumination and density throughout this rectangle. Do NOT include a cortex, shadows, fat, tissue interfaces, dark gradients, skull, porous industrial foam, tile repeats, mirrored periodicity, rings or cells. This is an extension of the reference's existing trabecular material into a large usable field.
BOTTOM LEFT: damaged tendon material in the same ivory/beige fine collagen style as the healthy tendon, with irregular dark small gaps and heterogeneous remaining fine fibers. Fibers interrupted and of varying thickness and quality, distributed throughout, while enough remaining fibers are visible. No red muscle, no vessels, no calcification, no bone, no huge coarse ropes. Use the reference paint style, do not invent a new material.
BOTTOM RIGHT: smooth almost black deep navy fluid with only very faint soft fine streaks, matching the large fluid pocket in the knee reference. Smooth, subtle, dark. No teal granular bubbles or sponge texture, no bright specks, no tissue interface.
Very high quality fine natural hand-painted medical tissue texture and softly shaded small fibers, matching the reference's restrained rendering. Every region filled edge to edge by only that material. No text, labels, arrows, annotations, framing, UI, ultrasound background, timestamps, scale or anatomy scene. This is an unlabeled material resource; the exact clinical contours will be supplied separately by code. Do not draw any patient anatomy.
